description: This source file defines and exports functions related to plugin SDK entry points, subpaths, and distribution artifacts for the openclaw project. It imports a JSON list of entry points and generates various mappings and lists for build and distribution purposes.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Returns an object mapping each plugin SDK entry point to its source file path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifier strings for plugin SDK entry points.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Generates an object mapping module paths to their corresponding type definitions and default JavaScript files for packaging.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Lists all distribution artifact file paths for plugin SDK entry points.
